Name: Aspen Mod - Anime Portraits
Author: M3M02112
Description:
How to install:
To install the mod, just unzip the archive and replace the portraits folder found inside the Aspen mod folder.
To find this folder you must go to your installed stardew valley files and once there you must access the following location:

\Stardew Valley\Mods\[CP] Aspen\assets

There you will only have to paste the “Portraits” folder you downloaded and replace the original mod folder.
